description: This file defines a specific exception class for errors related to AmazonMQ interactions within the AWS SDK for PHP. It extends from a general AWS exception class.

classes.name: MQException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing errors interacting with the AmazonMQ service, extending from the generic AwsException.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Inherits constructor from AwsException, specialized for MQ errors (not explicitly overridden in the code).
